## Arista Networks Falls 6.8% Despite Surging AI Orders and Raised 2026 Outlook

A post-earnings decline despite clear demand acceleration typically flags valuation crowding or margin credibility questions — the market appears to be demanding proof that AI networking revenue converts to durable margin expansion, not just top-line growth, which is the critical watch item for the networking thesis.

- ANET declined 6.8% despite reporting surging AI orders and raising its 2026 guidance.
- The sell-off on a fundamental beat suggests the market is skeptical of margin sustainability or that valuation had already priced in the upside.
